name: ANSI weatherproof receptacle plan symbol
summary: US plan symbol for an outdoor or damp-location receptacle, drawn as a duplex receptacle with a WP subscript.
description: Outdoor receptacles in US practice are drawn with the duplex receptacle form plus WP. The tag tells the installer to fit a weatherproof cover, and for many outdoor locations an in-use cover that stays weatherproof while a cord is plugged in.

WP receptacles are typically also GFCI protected, so plans often carry both tags or a general note. Mounting height above grade and proximity to pools or fountains are common notes next to the symbol. WP does not specify the enclosure rating or whether an in-use cover is required. The specification must state these.
readingNotes: Read WP and GFCI tags together.
Check for an in-use cover requirement.
distinction: The IEC weatherproof outlet uses an IP tag; the US form uses WP on the duplex receptacle symbol.
